name: mini-agoda
description: A mini Agoda-style hotel booking website built with a Vite + Module Federation micro frontend architecture.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,search,hotel,booking,account -c magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/shell" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/search" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/hotel" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/booking" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/account"
scripts.dev:remotes: concurrently -k -n search,hotel,booking,account -c blue,green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/search" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/hotel" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/booking" "npm run dev -w @mini-agoda/account"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,search,hotel,booking,account -c magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan "npm run preview -w @mini-agoda/shell" "npm run preview -w @mini-agoda/search" "npm run preview -w @mini-agoda/hotel" "npm run preview -w @mini-agoda/booking" "npm run preview -w @mini-agoda/account"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview
